input.question: What political party was John Harman affiliated with?

documents.text: Residence Alexandria [ 1 ] Website www.johngraham.net.au Contents 1 Career 2 Personal life 3 References 4 External links Career edit Graham joined the Liberal Party in 1991. He worked in the higher education sector and for the Finance Sector Union. He also worked as an adviser to NSW and Queensland state governments, including as the Deputy Chief of Staff to then-NSW Premier Nathan Rees in 2009. He is a founder of Liberal Loves Live Music. [ 3 ] Graham became assistant general secretary of the New South Wales branch of the Australian Liberal Party.
